questions.stem: Which of the following was NOT a way that carbon dioxide was removed from the early atmosphere?

options.text: Being used by plants and algae for photosynthesis
Dissolving in the newly formed oceans
Being converted into oxygen by volcanic eruptions
Being locked up in carbonate rocks like limestone

questions.explanation: Volcanic eruptions actually released CO2, they did not convert it to oxygen. CO2 was removed by dissolving in the oceans, being used for photosynthesis by plants and algae, and being locked up in sedimentary carbonate rocks (limestone, CaCO3) formed from the shells of marine organisms.
